description: Open trip one day trip (ODT) Gunung Papandayan bersama Atlantik Traveller Indonesia. Harga start from Rp180.000/orang. Jadwal trekking November 2026: weekend 1, 7, 8, 14, 15, 21, 22, 28, 29; weekday 3, 12, 16, 26. Jadwal trekking Desember 2026: weekend 5, 6, 12, 13, 19, 20, 26, 27; weekday 1, 10, 17, 24, 25, 31. Tanggal di atas adalah tanggal trekking; keberangkatan H-1 malam (contoh: trekking tgl 7 berangkat tgl 6 malam). Itinerary: malam meeting point Jakarta 20.00-21.00, Ciamis 21.00-21.30, Bandung 22.00-23.00, Tasikmalaya 22.00-23.00, Garut 01.00-01.30; tiba di basecamp 02.30-03.30; trekking & eksplor destinasi 04.00-13.00 (View Sunrise, Hutan Mati, Taman Edelweiss, Pondok Saladah); makan & persiapan pulang 13.00-14.00; perjalanan pulang, tiba Garut 15.30, Tasikmalaya 17.00, Ciamis/Bandung 18.00-18.30, Jakarta sekitar 21.00. INCLUDED: transportasi PP; driver, BBM, tol & parkir; tiket masuk; tour guide; makan 1x (setelah trekking); snack roti; air mineral; sticker/pin; P3K standar; basecamp; dokumentasi kamera (min. 13 peserta). EXCLUDE: perlengkapan pribadi; cemilan pribadi; jas hujan; uang jajan; obat pribadi. Syarat & ketentuan: terbuka untuk umum (sendiri, bareng teman/keluarga/pasangan); kuota terbatas (limited seat); booking seat sah setelah DP Rp150.000 (pelunasan maksimal H-3); peserta wajib sehat fisik & mematuhi arahan guide. Info & pendaftaran: WhatsApp 0819-3523-5393 • IG/TikTok @atlantik_traveller_id (jadwal: @jadwal_atlantiktraveller_id).
title_en: Open Trip Mount Papandayan - Atlantik Traveller Indonesia
description_en: One day trip (ODT) to Mount Papandayan with Atlantik Traveller Indonesia, starting from Rp180,000/person. Meeting point & price: Jakarta & Bekasi Rp370,000 • Bandung, Ciamis & Tasikmalaya Rp325,000 • Garut area Rp300,000 • Basecamp (no transport) Rp180,000. Trekking dates November 2026: weekends 1, 7, 8, 14, 15, 21, 22, 28, 29; weekdays 3, 12, 16, 26. Trekking dates December 2026: weekends 5, 6, 12, 13, 19, 20, 26, 27; weekdays 1, 10, 17, 24, 25, 31. The dates above are trekking dates; departure is the night before (e.g. trek on the 7th departs the night of the 6th). Itinerary: evening meeting points Jakarta 20:00-21:00, Ciamis 21:00-21:30, Bandung 22:00-23:00, Tasikmalaya 22:00-23:00, Garut 01:00-01:30; arrive at basecamp 02:30-03:30; trek & explore 04:00-13:00 (View Sunrise, Dead Forest, Edelweiss Garden, Pondok Saladah); meal & prep 13:00-14:00; return trip, back in Jakarta around 21:00. INCLUDED: round-trip transport; driver, fuel, toll & parking; entrance ticket; tour guide; 1 meal after trekking; bread snack; mineral water; sticker/pin; standard first aid; basecamp; camera documentation (min. 13 participants). EXCLUDED: personal gear; personal snacks; raincoat; pocket money; personal medicine. Terms: open to everyone (solo, with friends/family/partner); limited seats; booking is valid after a Rp150,000 down payment (full payment by D-3); participants must be physically fit and follow the guide's instructions. Info & registration: WhatsApp 0819-3523-5393 • IG/TikTok @atlantik_traveller_id.
